messages:
Carla (oncall): CI integrations are red for hosted-integ this morning, most failures are the streaming+toolcall suites showing 401/403s. Any quick eyes? :rotating_light:
Ben - infra: saw that too. Failing tests spiked ~06:12 UTC, coincides with a small proxy roll earlier. Link to first failing shard: https://ci.internal/red/hosted-integ/shard-12/logs
Alice (runtime): can you paste one of the failing log stanzas? curious if it's auth handshake or header validation.
Ben - infra: pasted snippet from shard logs:
```
2025-03-04T06:13:15Z ERROR handler: auth failure status=401 details="missing session header: x-rw-session"
2025-03-04T06:13:15Z DEBUG proxy: incoming headers: Authorization=Bearer ***; x-session-token=abc123
```
Ben - infra: tests send x-session-token but proxy expects x-rw-session now after the header-normalization change.
Dmitry (platform): ah — the proxy normalization PR that landed yesterday renamed session header. We added a translation in hosted runtime but looks like the integ harness uses the test client library which wasn't updated.
Ryan (eng): quick repro locally: run integ suite with TEST_CLIENT=legacy-client -> see same 401. Patch suggestion: either accept x-session-token in proxy OR add shim in gateway for header aliasing.
Alice (runtime): prefer shim in proxy for backwards compat. I can open a 1-line hotfix to map x-session-token -> x-rw-session in the edge handler. Will run a canary.
Carla (oncall): can someone trigger a rerun of the failing shards after the patch? Otherwise we can short-circuit via a bisect to find exact PR that introduced rename.
depolyer-bot: build/hosted-proxy@v2.18.1 deployed to canary (canary-03) at 2025-03-04T06:28:42Z :rocket:
Ben - infra: kicked off rerun for shards 12-15 (CI job 98765).
Ryan (eng): adding a quick bisect plan in case rerun still fails:
- revert header-normalization commit locally -> run one shard
- if green, revert is culprit -> patch proxy shim
- if still red, check client lib changes
Dmitry (platform): FYI the client library release notes mention renaming to x-rw-session in PR#4123, but integ harness pinned an older client, so mismatch was expected after proxy change. We'll update harness in a follow-up.
Carla (oncall): rerun started; I'll monitor. If rerun passes, we ship shim and roll to prod. If rerun fails, we'll bisect. :eyes:
Ben - infra: CI rerun status: shard-12 -> green, shard-13 -> green, shard-14 -> green, shard-15 -> green. All four passed now.
Carla (oncall): looks like proxy shim worked. Can we also add a short test to the integ suite that verifies both header names are accepted? Prevents regressions.
Alice (runtime): will add a tiny unit/integration check and open PR against integ harness to bump client pin. Assigning to me, pinging @Dmitry for review.
Ryan (eng): thanks all for quick turnaround. Leaving notes in the incident tracker and will mark CI-green once PRs merge. :thumbsup:
